body:
This comment records the public documentation search for issue #795 (`tormach-8l.mch`, `tormach-15l-slant-pro.mch`, `tormach-15lx-slant-pro.mch`, and `tormach-lathe.cps`).

## Findings

| Point | Finding | Source | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tormach-8l.mch` (`spindle.rigid_tapping`) | Confirm `spindle.rigid_tapping` as `true`. The 8L lathe has a spindle encoder and supports rigid tapping with `G33.1` (`Z` depth, `K` lead, optional `I` return multiplier) on the centerline (`X0`). | *8L Operator's Manual (UM10753)*, section 10.3.18, p. 151 ("10.3.18 Rigid Tapping (G33.1)", https://tormach.com/support/manuals/um10753-8l-operators-manual); *PathPilot Tools and Features - 8L* ("Tap uses electronic gearing (G33.1, Rigid Tapping)", https://knowledgebase.tormach.com/pathpilot-tools-and-features-8l); *Tormach Lathes* ("Rigid Tapping ($1,800+ value)", https://tormach.com/machines/lathes) | Stated in the source |
| `tormach-15l-slant-pro.mch` (`spindle.rigid_tapping`) | Confirm `spindle.rigid_tapping` as `true`. The 15L Slant-PRO has a standard spindle encoder (PN 32560) and supports rigid tapping with `G33.1` (`Z` depth, `K` lead) on `X0`. A non-zero `X` value causes a crash hazard. | *15L Slant-PRO Operator's Manual (UM10225)*, section 6.5.17, p. 127 ("For rigid tapping, program G33.1 Z~ K~.", https://tormach.com/media/resources/manuals/UM10225_15L_Slant-PRO_Manual.pdf); *Programming - 15L* (https://knowledgebase.tormach.com/15l/programming-15l and https://knowledgebase.tormach.com/docs/programming-15l) | Stated in the source |
| `tormach-15lx-slant-pro.mch` (`spindle.rigid_tapping`) | Confirm `spindle.rigid_tapping` as `true`. The 15LX Slant-PRO has an integrated spindle motor encoder on EtherCAT and supports rigid tapping with `G33.1` (`Z` depth, `K` lead) on `X0`. | *15LX Slant-PRO Operator's Manual (UM10860)*, Version 0326A, section 10.3.13 ("For rigid tapping, program G33.1 Z~ K~", https://manuals.plus/tormach/um10860-15lx-slant-pro-operators-manual and https://tormach.com/support/documentation/15lx-lathe-documents/); *Tormach 15LX* ("Rigid Tapping", https://tormach.com/15lx) | Stated in the source |
| Lathe tapping code (`G84` note in #795 vs `G33.1` in `tormach-lathe.cps`) | Correct the `G84` assumption for lathes. `G84` is the mill canned tapping cycle (`X Y Z R P F`); Tormach lathes use `G33.1` for rigid tapping. The word order is `G90`, `G0` to `X0` and start `Z`, `G97` with `S` and `M3` or `M4`, then `G33.1` with `Z` depth and `K` lead (and optional `I` return multiplier). PathPilot blocks `G33.1` in `G96` mode. | *Service Bulletin SB0046 (PathPilot v2.7.0, PP-3042)* ("prevent G33.1 rigid tapping in G96 mode and protect against tap breakage", https://tormach.com/support/software-downloads/legacy-pathpilot); *LinuxCNC G-Code Reference*, G33.1 and G84 sections (https://linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode/g-code.html); *UM10225* section 6.5.17; *UM10860* section 10.3.13 | Stated in the source and seen in an example program |

## Not found

- We did not find a PathPilot release note that ties `G84` to a Tormach lathe model and spindle (`SB0046` links `G33.1` and `G96` instead).
- We did not find exact PDF page numbers for `UM10860` section 10.3.13 or direct PDF file URLs for `UM10753` and `UM10860` (only Tormach support pages and web text mirrors were visible).
- We did not find exact spindle reversal overshoot values or `I`-word limits per lathe model (`8L`, `15L`, `15LX`) during `G33.1`.

## Suggested changes (no code)

- Set `rigid_tapping` to `true` in `assets/machines/tormach-8l.mch`, `assets/machines/tormach-15l-slant-pro.mch`, and `assets/machines/tormach-15lx-slant-pro.mch`, and record `UM10753`, `UM10225`, and `UM10860` in a `docs/decisions/` file.
- Update `every_tormach_mill_and_router_file_states_rigid_tapping` in `crates/app/tests/rigid_tapping.rs` (or add a lathe test) to check `spindle.rigid_tapping` on the three Tormach lathe files while keeping `tormach-1300pl.mch` outside the check.
- Keep the `TAP` refusal in `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps` until a later task adds `G33.1` output; do not write `G84` for Tormach lathes.
- When a later task adds `G33.1` output to `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps`, check for `X0` centerline alignment, require `G97` constant RPM mode (refuse `G96`), start the spindle before the block, and write `G33.1` with `Z` depth and `K` lead.

**Important:** You still need a check on a real PathPilot lathe control before you cut a part.
